body_markdown:
With sales of €265.5m in the third quarter of 2026, up 4.8% at current exchange rates and 4.6% at constant exchange rates compared with the third quarter of 2025, Interparfums regained momentum in an environment that remains turbulent, particularly in the Middle East and Eastern Europe.
